.kitchen
Oats khichdi nuskha | vistrit photo aur vidiyo nuskha ke sath svasth vajan ghatane khichri nuskha. mung dal aur rold ots ke sath taiyar ek atyant saral aur aasan svasth purn bhojan nuskha. mul rup se, chaval ke anaj ko ek malaeedar aur svadisht purn bhojan ke lie lurhka huaa jaee ke sath badal diya jata hai. yah ek aadarsh lanch boks ya tifin boks bhojan ho sakta hai, yadi nashte aur rat ke khane ke lie nahin, to dahi rayta aur masaledar garm achar ke ek udar skup ke satha.
